# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.4.x   | yes       |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Found a security issue? Please don't open a public issue.

Email: **barbara.jones63499@gmx.com**

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the Watson version. You'll
get a reply within a few days.

Watson only reads information that is already public — it never needs your
passwords, cookies or accounts to work.
